pages.text: Several mods add the same metal. Instead of keeping four steels apart, recipes ask for an $(thing)item tag$(): "any steel ingot", and every mod's steel qualifies.$(br2)The items stay different and do not stack together.

pages.title: Steel Ingot
pages.text: Alloyed's steel. Three other mods add an item with the same name. Check the mod name in the tooltip or in JEI.

Four steel ingots exist: Alloyed, TFMG, Create Nuclear and Create Big Cannons.$(br2)All sit in the steel ingot tag, with matching nugget and block tags. A recipe written for the tag takes any of them. JEI cycles through the choices.
pages.title: Steel
TFMG Steel
pages.text: The one made by TFMG's blast furnace chain: $(l:industry/tfmg_steel)TFMG Steel$(/l). It counts as steel in tag-based recipes of other mods.
Plates are shared too: Alloyed's Steel Sheet and TFMG's Heavy Plate are both in the steel plate tag, so a recipe asking for steel plate can take either.
pages.title: Steel plates

pages.text: $(li)$(item)Lead$(): TFMG and Create Nuclear share ingot, nugget, block and raw tags. Only Nuclear's lead ore generates.$(li)$(item)Bronze$(): Alloyed and Create Big Cannons.$(li)$(item)Cast iron$(): TFMG and Create Big Cannons.
pages.title: Other shared metals
Cast Iron Ingot
pages.text: Shared by TFMG and Create Big Cannons through the cast iron tag, so either works in tag-based recipes.
Not shared: titanium, tungsten, platinum, mithril and zinc each come from one mod, so there is one item to find.$(br2)Northstar's Martian Steel has its own tag and is not generic steel.
pages.title: Single-source metals

pages.text: Raw uranium joins from Create Nuclear and Alex's Caves, and sulfur dust from Alex's Caves and TFMG.$(br2)If a recipe refuses an item, it asks for a specific one, not the tag. JEI shows a tag as a cycling icon.
